SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION

Exception codes sent in SIMCONNECT_RECV_EXCEPTION packets to indicate which client request triggered an error.

Name Value Description
SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION_NONE 0 No error has occurred.
SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION_ERROR 1 An unspecified error has occurred in the SimConnect server.
SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION_SIZE_MISMATCH 2 The size of the data definition does not match the size of the data structure supplied by the client.
SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION_UNRECOGNIZED_ID 3 A client-defined identifier supplied in the request is not recognised by the server.
SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION_UNOPENED 4 The client attempted to call a SimConnect function before successfully opening a connection.
